usedFor: ActivityInfo is where a programme team collects its field data, and Slack is where they talk about it. A “New Record” or “Updated Record” in ActivityInfo can post “Send Message as Thread” in Slack, so each change is discussed under an existing message.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Record” in ActivityInfo, then “Send Message as Thread” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Edits to a record are what a team needs to talk about, and a thread reply keeps those changes in one place. “Send Message as Thread” can send now or at a scheduled time.

watchOut: “Send Message as Thread” replies to an existing thread, so you need to give it one. Both ActivityInfo triggers are polling and run on a schedule. In 50agents, a post to a Slack channel waits for your approval.
